items.answer:
The original of the complete circulated video was not confirmed; the candidate was https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZRWeZzN9nmQ, with recorded upload and earliest archive dates of 2025-01-06.[E46][E41] Only 27% of the circulated video's half-second samples matched consistently, so the comparison did not establish this candidate as the source of the whole video.[E41]

Removed, added, reordered or visually altered footage—and paired timestamps for those changes—could not be determined from the insufficient consistent picture correspondence.[E41]

For sound, the comparison reported differences between circulated-video 47.0–90.0 s and candidate-video 0.2–43.2 s, but the weak independent audio alignment (envelope correlation 0.16; zero of 85 one-second windows matching) does not establish audio replacement or reliable corresponding times.[E41]

These results leave the complete source and edit inventory unresolved; they do not establish that the circulated video is unedited.[E41]

A and B show corresponding street footage, but B includes a central person wearing a black shirt and gray shorts where A shows pavement, clearly visible in paired views at 0.000 s and 5.2 s.[E25][E28][E21] At 5.2 s, this changes the apparent performance from three foreground participants in B to two in A, omitting the central person's involvement relative to B.[E21]

The comparison reports matches for 100% of A's half-second samples and pixel differences across A [0.000, 5.680) s and B [0.000, 5.680) s; that measured interval does not establish the person's absence through continuous visual inspection.[E24]

Sound matched in all 10 tested windows.[E24] Speech recognition returned no speech segments for A and “You” at 0.0–2.0 s for B, but these inconsistent transcriptions do not establish an audible difference or verified wording.[E31][E32]

B's original-source status and the direction of editing remain undetermined; unsampled visual intervals, exact audible content and facial correspondence were not verified, so the evidence does not establish that everything else is identical.[E24][E31][E32]
